title: 类别库存周转率及周转天数
context: 仓储部门比较不同仓库与品类的资金效率。
requirements: 2025年：净销售出库成本含退货冲回；年初价值以2024-12-31快照、年末以2025-12-31快照；平均库存=两端均值；周转天数365/周转率，销售成本非正时天数NULL。
commonError: 销售额不是出库成本；逐商品周转率的简单平均也不是类别周转率。
executionSteps: 分别汇总期间净成本和两端快照
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(CASE WHEN movement_type='sale' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents WHEN movement_type='return' THEN -quantity_delta*unit_cost_cents ELSE 0 END) cogs FROM stock_movements m JOIN products p ON p.product_id=m.product_id WHERE movement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id), b AS (SELECT warehouse_id,p.category_id,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents)/2.0 avg_stock FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE snapshot_date IN ('2024-12-31','2025-12-31') GROUP BY warehouse_id,p.category_id) SELECT b.warehouse_id,b.category_id,COALESCE(a.cogs,0) cogs_cents,b.avg_stock avg_stock_cents,ROUND(COALESCE(a.cogs,0)/NULLIF(b.avg_stock,0),4) turnover,CASE WHEN a.cogs>0 THEN ROUND(365.0*b.avg_stock/a.cogs,2) ELSE NULL END turnover_days FROM b LEFT JOIN a ON a.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND a.category_id=b.category_id ORDER BY b.warehouse_id,b.category_id
